features.title: Focused Shadow Crypt guidance
features.reference_feature: Focused Experience Mode on supported quests
features.gap: Standard Rift Nave guidance prioritizes the optional Cooling Cache before the main objective.
features.adaptation: Reversible Focused guidance points at StabilizeRiftNode while preserving optional cache state and actions.
features.acceptance: Invalid or repeated mode requests do not mutate state; Focused mode cannot remove or auto-complete the cache.

features.title: Explicit entry prerequisite report
features.gap: Fresh Shadow Crypt entry returns only success/failure to its direct mission caller.
features.adaptation: Read-only lead progress and exact mission-state blocker for initial entry.
features.acceptance: Incomplete lead, active run, checkpoint, completed replay requirement, and ready state are distinct and deterministic.

features.title: Prerequisite-specific next action
features.gap: Callers otherwise have to duplicate field-guide and mission-state interpretation.
features.adaptation: Return the exact next authored action without changing the currently tracked field operation.
features.acceptance: Missing sigil, missing lore, ready entry, active run, checkpoint, and completed replay produce bounded distinct guidance.

features.title: Latest clear versus personal-best result
features.reference_feature: Result presentation includes historical best record
features.gap: Shadow Crypt retains a personal best but has no latest-clear comparison report.
features.adaptation: Expose latest accepted clear, retained best, non-negative score gap, and new-best flag.
features.acceptance: A worse replay cannot replace the best and scoreBehindBest never becomes negative.

features.title: Bounded All Records clear archive
features.gap: Only one best record is retained.
features.adaptation: Retain four newest accepted clears newest-first while personal best remains independent and monotonic.
features.acceptance: Exactly one entry per clear, capacity four, out-of-range reads invalid, dropping an old archive entry cannot drop best.

features.title: Pre-entry Shadow Crypt encounter intel
features.current_resolution: Unverified. Treated as a historical player preference for seeing encounter information before commitment, not as proof of a current Genshin defect.
features.gap: No compact pre-run mission-structure preview exists.
features.adaptation: Read-only room requirements, optional-cache availability point, and Rift Warden finale using existing authored facts only.
features.acceptance: Preview is available before Begin and cannot mutate mission or field state.
